name: Crush Corp
summary: Crush Corp is a Giantess themed video game actively being developed by the Heavenly team. It is set in the Perfect Order Universe, a storyline featured in both the game and animations made by the Heavenly team. The player takes the role of a scientist named Avery, who is 'employed' by Emi to scan the universe for Soul Signals. It is up to the player to manage the Crush Corp building, discover soul signals and interact with the girls they make contact with - all while making sure their boss is satisfied with their performance.
